note: A single back-in gravel site for up to six people in an open meadow in full sun on Beech Creek Road, next to a natural gas compressor station, so expect industrial noise. The agency's route from PA 150 runs up Monument Orviston Road, Falls Road and Beech Creek Road (9.9 miles), Beech Creek Mountain Road (1.5 miles), then Beech Creek Road again for 2.7 miles; the site is on the right. No table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: SS017 still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle 50 ft (equipment length 25), gravel back-in, grades Slight, six people; count 1 and 50 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Season year-round confirmed; sells in all three windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA): pin in an open meadow about 60 m north of a compressor station and its gravel yard; pad not distinct, pin not moved. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured): this page does NOT carry the dirt-or-gravel-road Caution line most Sproul pages do. 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', gravel. No Severe grade, 4WD, wet-weather or clearance statement. Kept. Boilerplate on every Sproul page, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

Setting: 'Description: This campsite in near a compressor station on Beech Creek Road.' Imagery shows the station (building, fenced equipment pad, large gravel yard) about 60 m south of the pin. 'Expect industrial noise' in the note is an inference from that, not an agency statement; cut it if unwanted.

Figures: 'Max Vehicle Length: 50' beside 'Equipment Length: 25' and 'Length of spur to wheelstop: 20' on a 60 x 45 ft site with a 60-ft driveway. All exceed 23 ft except the spur; 50 ft kept, figures in the sites note.
Pin: matches the booking page and GIS point; the meadow has several tracks and no distinct pad at the pin. Not moved, no candidate.
ATV check (ruling 1): nothing on the site page, GIS record or district map places this site in an ATV parking lot. Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): no closure or restriction on this site's road; it carries the Bloody Skillet Orviston-lot section closure, the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads', a dust advisory and a firewood-cutting road list.

NAME: the '(Snow Shoe)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label ('Site, Loop: SS017, Snow Shoe'). It is on Beech Creek Road beside a gas compressor station, 2.7 miles past Beech Creek Mountain Road; the district map puts it close to PA 144 near sites SS014 and SS015. Suggest a name that says where it is; apply.py does not write names.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the district's 2025 map labels CR001-CR021 plus the WS series, and the CR booking pages list 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'. Nothing here depends on it.
